what: Three altered copies of each improving certificate, decided by this repository's two exact checkers and by the source's two, as retained: the tightest pair overlapped by moving one square along its closing normal by the exact gap plus one unit of the side's denominator (doubled until it overlaps), and the box shrunk past its least top or right clearance by that unit, both of which every checker must refuse; and the box shrunk by the unit alone, which is still a valid certificate where the clearance exceeds it.
